folds.title: Step 1: reading
points: A model reads a huge amount of text.
It practises one task again and again: guess the next word.
Each wrong guess nudges its settings a little.

folds.title: Step 2: learning to help
points: After many rounds, it picks up grammar, facts and how people write.
Then more training with human feedback teaches it to be helpful, honest and careful.

folds.title: After training
points: It does not learn from your chat on its own.
New knowledge needs new training or a search.

folds.title: Biscuit the dog

chat.you: My dog is called Biscuit. Ideas for her birthday?

chat.label: A new chat
chat.claude: Happy to help! What's your dog's name?

folds.note: A new chat starts fresh, unless memory is on.

folds.prompt: Tap each card to flip a myth into what really happens.

cards.weak: Myth: Claude is searching a giant database of answers.
cards.strong: It predicts new text from patterns it learned.
cards.note: Nothing is copied out of a stored answer list.

cards.weak: Myth: Claude learns from me live as we chat.
cards.strong: It only uses the chat as context. The model itself stays the same.
It knows what was in its training, which has a cutoff and gaps.
